 1 | Flowstop III | 1 target | - | touch | U

 4 | Clotting III | 1 target | - | touch | U

13 | Unclotting | 1 target | P | touch | U

20 | Joining True | 1 target | P | touch | U

50 | Blood Repair True | 1 target | 1 rnd/lvl | touch | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster can stop bleeding on a wound that is bleeding up to 3 hits per round
(total). Target may not be moved or bleeding will resume at prior rate.
@@ 2
Caster may stop bleeding on a wound that is bleeding 1 hit per round. For 1
hour, target can move at no more than a walking pace or bleeding will resume
at prior rate.
@@ 3
Allows caster to stop bleeding from 1 wound that is bleeding at rate of 1 hit
per round.
@@ 4
As Clotting I, except that caster can stop up to 3 hits per round (total) of
bleeding in a woud.
@@ 5
Allows caster to completely mend a damaged minor blood vessel (a vessel that
bleeds at up to 3 hits per round, not major arteries or veins).
@@ 6
As Cut Repair I, except that caster can repair wound(s) that bleed(s) for up
to 3 hits per round (total); three 1 hit per round wounds or one 3 hits per
round wound or one 2 hits per round and one 1 hit per round wound can be
healed.
@@ 7
Caster can repair any one damaged vein. Target cannot move (under his own
power) without reopening wound. Recovery time is 1-10 days.
@@ 8
Allows caster to repair any one damaged artery. Target cannot move (under his
own power) without reopening wound. Recovery time is 1-10 days depending upon
the size of the artery and the severity of the damage.
@@ 9
Allows caster to reattach 1 severed limb. Also requires the use of the other 3
Lay Healer Joining spells to make limb fully functional. Limb is fully
functional after 10-100 days.
@@ 10
As Flowstop III, except that all blood loss (i.e., hits per round) from one
wound is stopped.
@@ 11
Target is kept in a state of suspended animation and prevented from dying for
the duration of this spell (i.e., the body is “preserved” and the “soul” will
not leave the body). Also requires the use of the other Suspend Life I spell
(on the Nerve and Organ Mastery list).
@@ 12
As Clotting I, except that all blood loss (i.e., hits per round) from one
wound is stopped.
@@ 13
Allows caster to remove any one blood clot. Will counter Clotting Curse (on
the Evil Cleric list, Curses). This spell has no affect on bleeding wounds
that have clotted (i.e., “clots” in this sense apply only to internal blood
clotting).
@@ 15
As Cut Repair I, except that it will stop bleeding and close any one wound.
@@ 17
As Suspend Life I, except for duration and the requirement of the other
Suspend Life II spell (on the Nerve and Organ Mastery spell list).
@@ 19
As Unclotting, except will affect all blood clots in the target.
@@ 20
As Joining, except caster must cast the other 3 Lay Healer Joining True spells
and the limb is fully functional in 10 minutes.
@@ 25
Allows caster to control all internal and external blood flow in the target.
As long as the target remains immobile, bleeding can be halted until the
wounds can be healed.
@@ 30
Allows caster to restore all the blood in any 1 target’s body. Recovery time
is 1-10 days.
@@ 50
Allows caster to cast one of the lower level spells on this list each round.
